description: The project's recorded conventions. Listed read-only: it has no scalar setting, conventions_version is pinned to 1 by scripts/validate-conventions.sh so it gets no bump rule, and the file is written by the j.conventions wizard rather than by jenga config.

keys.label: Conventions version
keys.description: Schema version, pinned to the integer 1 by the validator; never edited and never bumped by jenga config.

keys.label: Convention categories
keys.description: The recorded convention per category (commit format, branching, naming and so on); written by the j.conventions wizard, never by jenga config.
